_meta.description: Seven halls: operations, passage, permission, rotated space, relative scale, bodily input and timed obstruction. Scale is not a rigid motion.

beats.concept: arrival from primitives — the static shape is about to move
Collect a still cube. Add rising, turning and swelling to its moving demonstrations, then walk a ramp to the completed pickups.
Three ways to cross a gap: a surface travels, a cube grows to meet the banks, a narrow plank turns into alignment.
Seven journeys separate and combine x, y and z. At the exit, two hand-operated mechanisms share a destination but permit different paths.
First cross and climb with centred blades; then compare four increasingly rotated arrays. A short tunnel and five cake profiles carry rotation into architecture.
A four-metre room grows fourfold. The body keeps its size; descend the serving tower and compare a growing doorway with a fixed museum frame.
Approach turns slats, contact removes cells, proximity shrinks blocks. Two openings close behind you; one records your passage.
Position, orientation and size follow clocks. Read the moving obstacles and find when your body can pass.
synthesis — the player carries translation + rotation + scale forward as a unified vocabulary
beats.note: A vocabulary of operations carried into repeated and generated arrangements.
